# Noobot v4.3.0

This release adds new model support, fixes Claude cache-hit behavior, optimizes the codebase, and resolves runtime bugs.

- Add GPT-6 Astra to the canonical model library and runtime configuration flow.
- Fix Claude prompt caching through the native Anthropic Messages API.
- Optimize model adaptation, response normalization, runtime topology, and client code paths.
- Fix bugs affecting model execution, protocol validation, reconnect handling, and desktop startup.
